name: shell-bottombar-grid
description: Bottom navigation bar + tile grid. A surface scanned like an app launcher. A brand row (the logo, or the name as text when there is none) sits on top.
provenPattern: Shell matrix — chrome × body: 5 chromes × 4 bodies = 20, four eliminated (with no chrome a grid has no way out, a dense surface has no interaction, a split refutes itself) → 16 cells.

knowledge.purpose: The frame of a start screen scanned on a narrow screen: tiles are shortcuts, the bottom bar switches sections
useCases: An announcement board on a narrow screen
antiPatterns: Making the tiles the same as the bottom-bar destinations — the same destination in two places
Leaving the grid at three columns — a narrow screen is one or two columns
Giving a tile the full screen height — a board must be scanned at a glance

mobileCollapse: Already the narrow-screen form — on desktop the bar stays put, the destinations spread. The grid collapses to one column and tile priority is declared SEPARATELY — grid order does not give it.

placeholders.{{BRAND}}: brand name as TEXT (the site/app name) — drawn when there is no logo (a logo already carries the name) and always the logo's alt; needs no logo
placeholders.{{LOGO}}: OPTIONAL brand image URL, drawn 28px tall (width follows the picture) IN PLACE of the name; leave it empty ("") when there is no logo and the name is drawn as text
placeholders.{{BAR_ITEMS}}: bottom-bar destinations: [{label, href, icon}] — one item per REAL destination of the app, at most five; never invent, pad or repeat one to fill the bar
placeholders.{{MAIN}}: main slot — TILES only (cards, stats, charts): every child is one grid cell, so a page band does not go here
placeholders.{{LEGAL}}: copyright / legal line — PLAIN TEXT, one line (e.g. "© 2026 Acme Ltd."). The ONLY place the copyright appears: the `footer` band carries link columns and never a copyright. Leave it empty ("") for none
